_about: RunPod pod template fields for the gpu-4090 pack. GAP: no RunPod account was used in building this pack and no template was created or tested — validate field names against the RunPod console/API at deploy time; the values below (image, GPU, ports, volume, start behaviour) are the pack's requirements, not a tested template.
billing: per second (RunPod pricing/rent pages, verified 2026-10-28) — idle pods still bill; stop the pod when a batch finishes

cloud_type_options.ram_vcpus: UNVERIFIED — not listed on the public pages checked

container_start_command: bash <pack-checkout>/runpod/start.sh — start.sh resolves the pack dir from its own location, so any checkout path works
image: BUILT_FROM: gpu-4090/Dockerfile (build and push to a registry first — the Dockerfile is the source of truth; no prebuilt image is claimed to exist)
name: mochiichao-gpu-4090

storage.note: Models + jobs + outputs live on the network volume, never in the container image. Storage is billed extra: network storage $0.07/GB/mo under 1 TB, container/volume disk $0.10/GB/mo (RunPod pricing page, 2026-10-28). Volume size is an operator choice — GAP: minimum size is not stated here because the post-download measured total must come from download-manifest.json (several model sizes are GAP-flagged in MODELS-MANIFEST).
